## Outcome

<!-- What changes for a Hornbook user? -->

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck:scripts`
- [ ] `npm run test:scripts`
- [ ] `npm test -- --watch=false`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant harness flows exercised

## Safety

- [ ] No real journal, recording, transcript, key, `.env`, `work/` output or `journal/secrets.json` is included
- [ ] English and Italian catalogs remain in lockstep when UI copy changes
- [ ] User-visible behaviour and release notes are documented where appropriate
